home.status: pre-alpha scaffold — the player ships with H-105, charts and submissions arrive in later naryads

submit.title: Submit a track
submit.description: Publish your own music on HUK. You keep your files — HUK links to them and stores only metadata and hashes.
submit.betaNote: The platform is in an invite-only beta: create your artist profile by redeeming an invite code, then submit tracks.
submit.apiNote: Submission currently goes through POST /api/tracks (ARTIST sessions); the guided form ships with the console naryads.
